question: Who is the chairperson of National Commission for Women in India (As of July 2022)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rekha Sharma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Commission for Women **(NCW) is a **statutory body** established in **1992 **under the National Commission for Women **Act, 1990.**
 
• Its primary objective is to protect and promote the** rights of women** in India.
 
• **Rekha Sharma** was appointed as the** chairperson **of NCW in August 2018 for a period of** three years.**
 
• Her tenure was extended for **another three years **in August 2021, which means she will be the chairperson of NCW til**l August 2024.**
 
• Rekha Sharma is a well-known** social activist **and **women's rights advocate.**
 
• She has been associated with various NGOs and advocacy groups working for **women's empowerment and gender equality.**
 
• As the chairperson of NCW, Rekha Sharma has been actively involved in addressing various issues related to **women's safety, rights, and welfare.**
 
• She has also been advocating for **stricter laws and policies** to ensure gender justice and equality in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Girija Vyas** was the** chairperson of NCW **from September 2013 to September 2018.

 
 
• Prior to that, she was a **member of parliament** and held various **ministerial positions** in the government of India.
 
 
 
• **Mamta Sharma **was the chairperson of NCW from **August 2011 to September 2013.**
 
 
• She was also a member of the** Rajasthan Legislative Assembly** and held various positions in the Congress party.
